assignments.task: Isolate the remaining scalp, ear and chest stippling, then author a skin-only material candidate from the accepted original maps. Preserve authored color, UVs, normal-frame conventions and makeup/jewelry boundaries.

R2-06 baseline views and diagnostic capture contract
acceptance: Change one material variable per diagnostic candidate; include unchanged control and exact source hashes.
Residual stippling must diminish in matched front, three-quarter and ordinary-camera views without bleaching indigo/gold, losing skin form or adding waxy halos.
If maps change, retain generation parameters, exact channels, color-space intent, license and byte hashes.
rejection_gate: Reject a candidate accepted only from a different camera, exposure, pose, light or LOD.
Reject new color seams, UV changes, blurred face structure, unstable highlights or an unsupported claim that the prior shadow correction solved all skin defects.
assignments.review_disposition: Executed assignment; see pinned report and final R2-15 review for accepted and rejected scope.

assignments.task: Prepare review fixtures using the current courtyard and Confluence backgrounds to test face/background separation and reflected-light context. Select existing architecture; add no new ornament.
acceptance: Provide fixed coordinates for close face and gameplay-scale face views against light stone, dark foliage and indigo/gold context in day/night.
Every fixture records original scene identity and the absence of changes to collisions, architecture and practical-light budgets.
rejection_gate: Reject a fixture that conceals the face with scenery, changes world materials to flatter one candidate or adds unrelated geometry.
assignments.review_disposition: Executed assignment; see pinned report and final R2-15 review for accepted and rejected scope.

assignments.task: Define and compare controlled skin-lighting probes around the accepted shadow policy, keeping artistic skin changes distinct from shadow/contact changes.
dependencies: Round 1 shadow ablation and accepted bias evidence
acceptance: Baseline retains sun shadows and depth 0.2 / normal 0.35; every probe alters exactly one declared variable and restores it.
Check face, ear, scalp, neck and chest alongside jewelry, foot and ground shadows in courtyard and Confluence day/night.
Any proposed policy change must reduce its named defect while preserving visible fixed-view contacts; moving-camera limits remain explicit.
rejection_gate: Reject disabling all shadows or hiding remaining defects with broad bloom, fog or overexposure as a production fix.
Reject detached contact shadows, eye-socket collapse, light leaks or a policy accepted solely from one face portrait.
assignments.review_disposition: Executed assignment; see pinned report and final R2-15 review for accepted and rejected scope.

assignments.task: Build a deterministic shot list from the existing five accepted ability timelines to expose facial and neck deformation during aiming, draw, release, recoil and cancellation. Retain existing effects and gameplay.

Provide unobscured facial diagnostic takes and normal effects-on context takes; distinguish the two in metadata.
No damage, warning geometry, cooldown, projectile timing, gameplay camera or VFX design changes.
rejection_gate: Reject a pose-only action presented as an executed gameplay event, or a wall impact labeled target-hit evidence.
Reject added ornamental effects or face-only framing substituted for normal action visibility.
assignments.review_disposition: Executed assignment; see pinned report and final R2-15 review for accepted and rejected scope.

rejection_gate: Reject new eye penetration, lips separating into visible gaps, boundary cracks or changes to unrelated body locomotion.
Reject fixing a failed deformation by disabling the face writer, freezing expression or hiding eyes.
assignments.review_disposition: Executed assignment; see pinned report and final R2-15 review for accepted and rejected scope.
